# The unit suite stops at Example.spec.mjs: it reads the catalog file the group split removed

Owned and urgent: it stops `dev`'s whole unit job, so every pull request that takes `dev` in goes red. No `good first issue` label.

## Context

#21856 (merged 13:49Z) moved the catalog from `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` into one file per group under `apps/portal/resources/data/examples/`, read through `buildScripts/util/exampleCatalog.mjs` `readExampleCatalog()`. #21907 (#21835, merged after it) added `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/model/Example.spec.mjs`, written against the old single file. The two never met in one CI run.

## The Problem

`Example.spec.mjs:27` reads `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` at module load. The file is absent on `dev` (`f4b25a6a9e`), so the spec throws while the suite is being collected, and Playwright stops the run before any test executes.

## The Fix

Read the records through `readExampleCatalog(EXAMPLES_DIR)` with a top-level await, as `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` already does. The assertions don't change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `Example.spec.mjs` reads the split catalog, and its tests pass on `dev`.
- [ ] AC-2: The whole unit suite runs to its summary on `dev` with the fix (receipt: counts).

## Out of Scope

The href rule itself (#21835).
